control-last.role: secondary fixed-final-round diagnostic because development selected the unchanged initialization

protocol.primary_measure: Paired same-seed point-margin gain over frozen Pacer and equal-budget control, separately against attack and defend

bootstrap.unit: whole seed with both sides and all five rallies

protocol.promotion: No automatic promotion; report all opponents, branch probes, effect estimates and uncertainty

config.selection: Highest mean point margin vs adaptive attack and adaptive defense on development seeds; Pacer is a secondary regression check; first checkpoint wins ties
config.method: Both arms receive same pooled trajectories, observations, permutations and epochs. Only labels on the oversampled tactical paths differ; control always uses the original adaptive ATTACK teacher, even for states sourced from defender trajectories.
config.anchor: KL(initial Pacer probability distribution || current distribution), temperature 1, on all shared observations; same coefficient in both arms
config.scope: Finite rollout supervision may depend on branch context absent from six inputs; full held-out matches test transfer. No tactical calculations in inference.

representative.selection: First retained strict loss-to-win branch after at least one return whose full trajectory is observation-consistent and never loops.

seed_audit.note: Repeated development lists across bounded follow-ups are intentional; fresh seeds do not guarantee unseen physical states.

canonical_observation_overlap.equality: Numeric float32 values; signed zeros are equal
canonical_observation_overlap.scope: Overlap with tactical-path supervision only; pooled game and synthetic training observations are not included.

limitations: A consistent finite trajectory establishes a possible stateless mapping on visited states, not a general winning policy.
